content:
The Monsoon Math Camp is an online 6-day camp run by a few students at MIT, Oxford, IISc, etc. to introduce promising (and mostly Indian) high school students to higher math. For its 2021 edition, their team is looking for an instructor to conduct an in-camp ITP workshop using Lean. There will most probably be monetary compensation.

The camp will be held on July 3-4, 10-11, 17-18. You can take at most 6 sessions of 50 minutes each for the Lean workshop. Of course, you are welcome to take a smaller number of sessions if that seems better to you. Here is the camp's website: www.monsoonmath.org.

If you are experienced in Lean, passionate about outreach, and are willing to engage students in hands-on ITP sessions using accessible high-school level math, please send an email to contact@monsoonmath.org.

Our students are usually very bright (alums of the selection camp for the Indian IMO team, student researchers, etc), so while the prerequisites should ideally be at most high-school math, you can talk about complex ideas using that setup and expect the students to follow you comfortably.
